name: BITEZ - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Melon Berry
description:
Juicy, refreshing, and packed with flavor, our Melon Berry BITEZ gummies deliver a mouthwatering fusion of ripe melon and sweet mixed berries. These double-stacked delights aren’t just about taste—they’re infused with a powerful blend of Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP, bringing 1,000mg per piece for a truly elevated experience. Each pack includes two expertly crafted gummies, giving you a smooth, flavorful ride with every bite.

Melon Berry layers refreshing Melon with juicy Berry flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
